item.title: Cup Left of the Laptop

turns.text: Make a simple wide illustration of a desk viewed from above: an open laptop in the middle, a yellow cup to its left, and a closed blue notebook to its right. Leave space between them. No text, 16:9.

item.tests: Whether the output preserves explicit viewer-relative spatial relationships and object attributes.

answer_sheet.Viewpoint: Looking straight down at the desk.
answer_sheet.Object positions: Open laptop in the middle, yellow cup on the viewer's left of it, closed blue notebook on the viewer's right.
answer_sheet.Spacing: Leave visible space between the three objects.
answer_sheet.Illustration style: Simple illustration; other style details are your call.

must_haves: The desk is illustrated from a top-down viewpoint in a 16:9 frame.
An open laptop sits in the middle of the composition.
A yellow cup is visibly to the viewer's left of the laptop.
A closed blue notebook is visibly to the viewer's right of the laptop.
Visible desk surface separates the cup, laptop, and notebook; none overlaps another.
No text appears on the screen, notebook, or elsewhere.

turns.text: Make a simple wide illustration of a desk viewed from above: an open laptop in the middle, a yellow cup to its left, and a closed blue notebook to its right. Leave space between them. No text, 16:9.
turns.agent: I’ll create the desk and objects, then combine them into one overhead image with clear space between them and no text.

fields.value: A desk viewed from above, with an open laptop in the middle, a yellow cup to its left, and a closed blue notebook to its right; space between the objects and no text.
fields.quote: a desk viewed from above: an open laptop in the middle, a yellow cup to its left, and a closed blue notebook to its right. Leave space between them. No text

goal.why: The user requests a single illustration, not an edit to an existing asset.

plan.say: I’ll create the desk and objects, then combine them into one overhead image with clear space between them and no text.

params.prompt_or_change: An empty desk viewed directly from above, evenly lit, with no objects, lettering, or markings.
An open unbranded laptop viewed directly from above, blank screen and unmarked keys, isolated against a plain background.
A plain yellow cup viewed directly from above, without lettering or decoration, isolated against a plain background.
A closed notebook with a plain blue cover viewed directly from above, without lettering or decoration, isolated against a plain background.

steps.why: Create the closed blue notebook element.

params.extra: Use flux-2-klein, which supports four input pictures on the free tier.
params.prompt_or_change: Combine the supplied elements into one coherent directly overhead desk photograph: open laptop in the middle, yellow cup to its left, closed blue notebook to its right; leave clear gaps between all objects, match lighting and shadows, and include no text or additional objects.

steps.why: Combine the elements into the requested spatial arrangement.
